description: This PHP source file defines the ExternalAPIFactory class, which provides methods to discover, load, filter, and manage external API integrations within the SuiteCRM environment. It handles dynamic loading of API classes, caching, and access control based on connector configurations, supporting features like listing available APIs, filtering based on enabled connectors, and managing API-specific dropdowns.

classes.name: ExternalAPIFactory
classes.description: A factory class managing discovery, filtering, loading, and caching of external API integrations in SuiteCRM, supporting dynamic class loading, cache management, and API listing functionalities.

methods.name: filterAPIList
methods.description: Filters a list of API configurations to include only those that are enabled and properly configured based on connector status and authentication method.

methods.name: loadFullAPIList
methods.description: Loads the full list of API configurations, utilizing cache when available, scanning directories for API class files, and rebuilding cache as necessary.

methods.name: clearCache
methods.description: Deletes cached API list files to force a rebuild on next load.

methods.name: loadAPI
methods.description: Instantiates and returns an API class for the specified API name, performing authentication loading if required.

methods.name: listAPI
methods.description: Returns a list of APIs filtered by module and authentication requirements.

methods.name: getModuleDropDown
methods.description: Provides an associative array suitable for dropdown menus, listing APIs relevant to a given module.
